content: अभियोक्तृ {%a.%} Assailing, attacking, accusing. --{%m.%} ({@-क्ता@}) .²1 An enemy, assailant, invader; त्वय्युत्कृष्टबलेऽभियोक्तरि नृपे <ls>Mu. 4. 15</ls>; <ls>H. 3. 86</ls>. .²2 (In law) A complainant, plaintiff, accuser, prosecutor; तत्राभियोक्ता प्राक् पृष्टो ह्यभियुक्तस्त्वनन्तरम् <ls>Śukra. 4. 655</ls>; <ls>Ms. 8. 52</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 8.">58</ls>; <ls>Y. 2. 95</ls>. .²3 A pretender, claimant; a stronger party.
